title: 第11章 疯了吧你还要认证一品炼丹师第12章 弟子更喜欢命运掌握在自己手中
slug: 凡人修仙我让高冷女宗主孕气十足
content_zh:
陆成声音不小，他此言一出，嘲讽的声音犹如一个炸弹在所有人脑海中炸响。
王飞宇身旁簇拥的数位紫袍弟子瞬间目瞪口呆，嘴巴大张。
就连一侧看好戏的紫袍弟子也是表情僵住。
甚至连不少身穿青袍的内门弟子也是瞪大眼睛，一脸震惊的看着陆成。
好胆！！
你一个杂役弟子！
什么身份啊？！
你竟然当着这么多人的面，嘲讽内门长老王厉的孙子，王飞宇！！
还将王飞宇比作阿猫阿狗？！
不想活了吗？！
谁给你的勇气？！
这在不少人看来，这是作死！
陆成这一句话，等于是在刺激王飞宇，与之结仇！
他这么说，难道是有底气？
可他是一个杂役弟子啊？！
站在院子中央的墨尘居，嘴角也是抽了抽。
“你……”王飞宇瞳孔骤缩，脸色铁青，嘴唇更是气得发抖，脖子上青筋暴起，双手更是死死紧握，浑身剧烈颤抖着。
他脸上露出难以置信的表情，此刻他感觉自己脑瓜子嗡嗡的！
仿佛感觉自己听错了，出现了幻觉！
他爷爷是筑基大圆满修士，内门长老，作为他的孙子，从小走到哪，身边自然簇拥着一帮外门弟子来主动讨好他。

他奉爷爷之命，前来参加墨尘居的考核，务必要成为墨尘居的弟子，成为一名炼丹师。
他从小就有洁癖，四日前他初见陆成，看到陆成身上的杂役服，和那淡淡的臭味，道出这世上什么阿猫阿狗都来炼丹，言语之间更是看不起陆成。
他打心眼里看不起陆成，毕竟陆成只是一个杂役而已，在他看来，陆成根本不可能通过墨大师的考核，他更是说出若是陆成通过，他倒着走的话。
接着，他就被打脸了！
陆成不但通过了第一道考核，而且还是第一名的成绩！
这让他在众人面前脸面尽失，更有人调侃他之前说陆成若是通过考核，他倒着走的话，让他难堪！
从小到大，他何时受到这般打击！
谁知他看不起的陆成第二日更是径直坐到了他旁边，怀有洁癖的他，更是怒火攻心！
他打算让陆成早早滚出补天峰！
他贿赂丹童，毁去陆成要炼夺灵丹的三份药材，早点让他出局，免得脏了他的眼睛！
在他看来，陆成只是一个杂役，毫无背景，在看到炼制夺灵丹的药材成废渣后，应该知难而退。
他没想到，陆成竟然直接告到了墨尘居那里！
他也被墨尘居直接剥夺了考核的身份。
但让他更没想到的是，此刻的陆成，竟还在众目睽睽下，将这句话一字不差地还了回来。
他感觉自己的脸此刻正被陆成按在地上，狠狠摩擦！
他感觉自己的脸被周围人注视着，那些眼神中有嘲笑、玩味，他感觉自己的脸火辣辣的痛，宛如一把利刃，在他脸上划了数刀！
这时，陆成看着浑身都在颤抖的王飞宇，淡然道：“让开！”
王飞宇尽管此刻非常想拍死陆成，但他不敢在补天峰放肆。
毕竟他的爷爷王厉，见到墨尘居时，都是极为客气。
王飞宇目光死死盯着陆成，咬牙一字一字低吼道：“小子！！你给老子等着，你今日若是炼不夺灵丹……”

说着，他伸出手，在脖子面前狠狠一划！
威胁！
content_en:
Lu Cheng's voice was loud. As soon as he said this, his sarcastic voice was like a bomb exploding in everyone's mind.
The purple-robed disciples surrounding Wang Feiyu were stunned for a moment, with their mouths wide open.
Even the purple-robed disciple watching the show on one side had a frozen expression.
Even many inner disciples wearing green robes looked at Lu Cheng with wide eyes and shocked expressions.
So brave! !
You are a handyman disciple!
What is your identity? !
You actually mocked Wang Feiyu, the grandson of the inner sect elder Wang Li, in front of so many people! !
Comparing Wang Feiyu to a cat and a dog? !
Don’t want to live anymore? !
Who gave you the courage? !
In the eyes of many people, this is seeking death!
Lu Cheng's words are tantamount to irritating Wang Feiyu and making enemies with him!
Does he have the confidence to say this?
But he is a handyman disciple? !
Mo Chenju, who was standing in the center of the courtyard, also twitched the corner of his mouth.
"You..." Wang Feiyu's pupils shrank suddenly, his face turned livid, his lips were trembling with anger, the veins on his neck popped out, his hands were clenched tightly, and his whole body was trembling violently.
There was an expression of disbelief on his face, and he felt like his head was buzzing at this moment!
It seemed like I had heard wrongly and was hallucinating!
His grandfather was a Foundation Establishment Dzogchen monk and an inner sect elder. As his grandson, wherever he went since childhood, he was naturally surrounded by a group of outer sect disciples who took the initiative to please him.
On the order of his grandfather, he came to take part in Mo Chenju's assessment. He must become Mo Chenju's disciple and become an alchemist.
He has been a germophobe since he was a child. Four days ago, he met Lu Cheng for the first time. When he saw Lu Cheng's uniform and the faint smell, he said that all the cats and dogs in the world came to make elixirs, and he even looked down on Lu Cheng in his words.
He looked down on Lu Cheng from the bottom of his heart. After all, Lu Cheng was just a handyman. In his opinion, it was impossible for Lu Cheng to pass Master Mo's assessment. He even said that if Lu Cheng passed, he would go backwards.
Then, he was slapped in the face!
Not only did Lu Cheng pass the first assessment, he also ranked first!
This made him lose face in front of everyone, and some people even teased him by saying that if Lu Cheng passed the exam, it would embarrass him if he walked backwards!
Ever since he was a child, when had he been hit like this!
Unexpectedly, Lu Cheng, whom he looked down upon, sat directly next to him the next day. As a mysophobic man, he was even more furious!
He planned to let Lu Cheng get out of Butian Peak early!
He bribed Dantong to destroy the three medicinal materials Lu Cheng needed to refine the elixir, and get him out of the game early to avoid dirtying his eyes!
In his opinion, Lu Cheng was just a handyman with no background. After seeing that the medicinal materials for refining the elixir were turned into waste, he should have retreated.
He didn't expect that Lu Cheng would sue Mo Chenju directly!
He was also directly deprived of his assessment status by Mo Chenju.
But what he didn't expect was that at this moment, Lu Cheng was actually returning these words word for word in front of everyone.
He felt that his face was being pushed to the ground by Lu Cheng and rubbed hard!
He felt that his face was being stared at by the people around him, and there was ridicule and playfulness in those eyes. He felt that his face was burning with pain, as if a sharp knife had cut his face several times!
At this time, Lu Cheng looked at Wang Feiyu, who was trembling all over, and said calmly: "Get out of the way!"
Although Wang Feiyu wanted to shoot Lu Cheng to death at the moment, he did not dare to act recklessly in Butian Peak.
After all, his grandfather Wang Li was extremely polite when he saw Mo Chenju.
Wang Feiyu stared at Lu Cheng, gritted his teeth and roared word by word: "Boy!! Just wait for me, if you can't refine the elixir today..."
As he spoke, he stretched out his hand and slashed hard in front of his neck!
threaten!
